howItWorks.headline: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Choose your path and get started in minutes

step1.title: Create Your Group
step1.description: Click 'Create Group', give it a name, and choose whether it's private or public.
step1.tip: Private groups require an invite link. Public groups appear in the directory for anyone to join.

step2.title: Share the Invite Link
step2.description: Share your unique invite link via text, email, or social media. Friends click it to request to join.
step2.tip: For private groups: Only people with the link can request access. You can revoke the link anytime.

step3.title: Approve Members
step3.description: You'll receive notifications when people request to join. Review and approve members to add them to the group.
step3.tip: As admin, you're responsible for managing the approval queue. Members can't join until you approve them.

step4.title: Start Competing
step4.description: Once members are approved, everyone makes predictions and the leaderboard updates automatically. Let the games begin!
step4.tip: Continue managing members, customize settings, and set group prizes.

step1.title: Get an Invite Link
step1.description: Ask the group admin to send you the invite link. They can find it in their group settings.
step1.tip: Private groups don't appear in public searches. You must have the invite link to request access.

step2.title: Request to Join
step2.description: Click the invite link, review the group details, and submit your request to join.
step2.tip: You'll see the group name, member count, and description before requesting.

step3.title: Wait for Approval
step3.description: The group admin will review your request. You'll get notified when they approve or deny it.
step3.tip: Approval times vary by admin. Check back or wait for the notification!

step4.title: You're In!
step4.description: Once approved, you're part of the group. Make predictions and see how you stack up on the leaderboard!
step4.tip: Your existing predictions count toward the group leaderboard immediately.

step1.title: Browse Public Groups
step1.description: Click 'Discover Public Groups' to see all open groups. Filter by size, activity, or tournament.
step1.tip: Public groups appear in the directory—no invite link needed! See member counts and descriptions.

step2.title: Request to Join
step2.description: Click any group to see details and description. When you find one you like, submit your request to join.
step2.tip: You can request to join as many groups as you want—private or public!

step3.title: Wait for Approval
step3.description: The group admin will review your request. You'll get notified when they approve you.
step3.tip: Even public groups require approval to maintain group quality and prevent spam.

step4.title: Start Competing!
step4.description: Once approved, you're in! Your predictions count toward the leaderboard and you can see how you rank.
step4.tip: Your existing predictions are immediately included in the group standings.
